contract.purpose: Help a person discover more ways a life can be lived and turn the possibilities that call to them into honest, personal journeys.
contract.canonicalPurpose: Live helps a person turn passive wanting into a life they can deliberately imagine, plan, and experience.
contract.audience: Adults who want meaningful goals, possibilities, and experiences to look forward to, including dreams the native catalogue has never seen.
contract.job: Enlarge the user's sense of what is possible, preserve any exact dream, and offer one coherent next move without pretending Live covers the whole world.
contract.thesis: An open world with a curated spine: one sunlit Life Atlas where native possibilities, uniquely personal dreams, and sourced outward research form one continuous journey.
contract.system: Warm paper and olive ink hold the private atlas; large yellow, sky, coral, sage, and lilac fields distinguish discovery states. Serif landmarks lead through open paths and contour lines while compact sans-serif controls preserve clarity and accessibility.
contract.signature: A future-life trail that visibly branches from an exact dream into confidence-only native matches and honest wider-world doors.
contract.risk: An infinite atlas can become overwhelming or feel like a search-results page, so each surface leads with one dominant possibility and progressively reveals breadth, provenance, and action.

projectCheck.command: pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint

ownerFeedback.note: The owner approved the open-world Life Atlas direction and delegated implementation with 'go for it'.
